lines.x: Nvidia has suspended shipments of powerful artificial intelligence chips to China, its interim CEO said, raising doubts over a special licensing agreement negotiated between Washington and Beijing.
Brent crude futures traded up 17 cents at $92.12 a barrel as rising expectations for a supply surplus and higher interest rates were counterbalanced by shipping attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
China imported 19.7 million tons of crude oil from Persian Gulf producers excluding Iran in October, representing a 42.4% increase from September.
Shares of Baidu fell to an all-time low as investors reacted negatively to third-quarter financial results and mounting concerns over its artificial intelligence monetization.
